mission: Design the 2-worker and 5-worker identical-bootstrap race canary, including expected claim collisions, losing-worker retry behavior, evidence, pass/fail conditions, vanished-worker cases and non-duplication assertions. Do not execute production mutation tests.
acceptance_criteria: 2-worker and 5-worker scenarios are executable and deterministic enough to falsify claim/retry behavior
expected create-if-absent collision and loser retry behavior are explicit
evidence paths and pass/fail assertions are machine-auditable
vanished-worker/stale boundary is covered without declaring silence failure
non-duplication and authority invariants are explicit

context_receipt.live_race_evidence: Multiple higher-priority claim attempts were observed as already claimed or lost between exact-path absence checks and create-if-absent attempts during this wake cycle. This is observational input, not pass evidence for the canary.

checkpoints: CP1 derive race model/invariants from claim + stale protocols
CP4 add vanished-worker and late-return cases
